items.title: UK Offset Policy
items.summary: Securing additional UK industrial, capability, and economic benefit from selected overseas defence and security procurements.

items.title: Defence contracts to prioritise British jobs and skills
items.summary: Overseas firms winning UK defence contracts to be required to invest benefits back into the UK under new Offsets policy.

items.title: Minister for Defence Readiness and Industry, Luke Pollard MP, Keynote Speech at DPRTE 2026
items.summary: The Minister for Defence Readiness and Industry, Luke Pollard MP, opened the two-day DPRTE 2026 conference with a keynote speech addressing topics such as procurement, innovation and skills.

items.title: Defence Industrial Strategy (DIS) Offset Written Consultation
items.summary: This consultation seeks input on three questions on key aspects of offset policies. The policies support the Defence Industrial Strategy commitment to explore measures to support UK-based businesses.

items.title: Government launches 'Back British' industry call to action to boost UK jobs, businesses, and skills
items.summary: New measures will look to ensure that UK defence investment — even with overseas companies — benefits British business, British jobs and British skills

items.title: Defence Secretary's DSEI 2025 Keynote Speech

items.title: Defence Secretary Defence Investment Summit Speech

items.title: Minister for Defence Procurement and Industry, Luke Pollard, statement on Defence Industrial Strategy
